# The PC110 board binding remains App-local.  Its real firmware is a BYOB
# build input; generated bytes stay in the build tree and never enter Git.
add_library(mypc110-board STATIC pc110_config.c pc110_display.c pc110_ec_block.c
    pc110_ec_mailbox.c
    pc110_firmware.c pc110_font.c pc110_lpt.c pc110_machine.c pc110_plan.c)
target_include_directories(mypc110-board PUBLIC "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
target_link_libraries(mypc110-board PUBLIC types x86-core-machine x86-core-vl82c420
    x86-nxvm-machine
    x86-nxvm-board-base x86-nxvm-chip-f65535)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    target_compile_options(mypc110-board PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endif()

if(COMMAND nxvm_require_manifest)
    nxvm_require_manifest(ibm-pc110-tft)
    nxvm_require_profile_asset("ibm-pc110-tft/firmware/pc110-tft-bios-1995-09-19.rom" 262144
        "232101c88466f311bcc32fbc215a4d7569f695ce19f9c07ca67ce2aee5232312")
    nxvm_require_profile_asset("ibm-pc110-tft/firmware/pc110-kanji-font.rom" 1048576
        "9829fdb8281c12022dc3b77686044ed1a5213ab526ce4329f2841cd64171784c")
    set(mypc110_real_firmware_source
        "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/app-mypc110/firmware.c")
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${mypc110_real_firmware_source}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/app-mypc110"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
            "-DINPUT_BIOS_0=${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/ibm-pc110-tft/firmware/pc110-tft-bios-1995-09-19.rom"
            -DINPUT_BIOS_1=LIB_NULL -DINPUT_VIDEO=LIB_NULL -DINPUT_CMOS=LIB_NULL
            "-DINPUT_FONT=${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/ibm-pc110-tft/firmware/pc110-kanji-font.rom"
            "-DOUTPUT=${mypc110_real_firmware_source}"
            -P "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/x86-nxvm/product/embed_firmware.cmake"
        DEPENDS
            "${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/ibm-pc110-tft/firmware/pc110-tft-bios-1995-09-19.rom"
            "${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/ibm-pc110-tft/firmware/pc110-kanji-font.rom"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/x86-nxvm/product/embed_firmware.cmake"
        COMMENT "Embedding validated PC110 TFT firmware for bounded diagnostics"
        VERBATIM)
    add_library(mypc110-real-firmware STATIC EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
        "${mypc110_real_firmware_source}")
    target_link_libraries(mypc110-real-firmware PRIVATE types)
    target_include_directories(mypc110-real-firmware PRIVATE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

    add_library(mypc110-product STATIC product_binding.c)
    target_include_directories(mypc110-product PUBLIC "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src"
        "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
    target_link_libraries(mypc110-product PUBLIC mypc110-board mypc110-real-firmware
        x86-nxvm-product)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(mypc110-product PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()

    # This checks the real App entry and its embedded BYOB inputs without
    # declaring a deployed PC110 artifact before guest qualification.
    add_executable(mypc110-product-preview EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL main.c)
    target_link_libraries(mypc110-product-preview PRIVATE mypc110-product)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(mypc110-product-preview PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()
endif()
